posts.name: Chaitanya Mishra
posts.cooked:

posts.name: Adarsh "23F2" K
posts.cooked:
Dear Pranjal,

Permission denied happens in many cases.

  1. Private Key does not match the public key
  2. IP of se2001.ds changed (happens if you logged in before)
  3. Bad file permissions for the private key in your machine (you need to have it like 400 or 600, it’s your private key!)
  4. Private key has to be with you. Your Public key has to be in the authorized_keys at se2001.ds(.*) - the runapp portal mentioned below does that
  5. Maybe a wrong public key was pasted

After typing so much, I just checked the portal and it has a passwordless link too - that can make your life very easy - even if you lose your private key or forget it’s password

Try them ! BPT2 deadline is approaching soon. Best of lucks bud!
